sentence: The backyard is buried in leaves and dead weeds. Clean it all up.

observation.model_notes: Photo 1 and Photo 2 appear to show visibly different conditions and surroundings: Photo 1 is a bare, leaf-covered lawn under dormant deciduous trees with a small storage shed in the background; Photo 2 shows a partly green lawn with a section of dry, dead weeds/grass, a concrete bed curb, a rose bush, and houses with tile roofs in the background. Nothing in either photo confirms they are the same yard area — worth confirming with the customer that both are within the backyard boundary before scoping. Photo 2 also shows a small pile of cut/scrap lumber boards in the foreground; this looks like construction debris rather than tree branches, and was not called out as a service line since it wasn't part of the request and isn't a branch.

evidence.note: Ground is almost entirely obscured by a thick, continuous carpet of fallen leaves across the whole visible lawn area.
Foreground and mid-ground are covered in dense, dry, dead weeds and grass, with debris mixed in among the stalks.

service_lines.uncertain: Photo 2's background (tile-roofed houses, green lawn, rose bush) looks different enough from Photo 1's (bare trees, shed) that it's unclear if both photos are the same backyard or two distinct areas; treating both as backyard based on the customer's wording, but this should be confirmed on site.
